Principles of Protection:

  • Least Privilege: Granting minimum privileges necessary for a task to reduce risk.

  • Separation of Privilege: Multiple conditions to grant access, enhancing security.

  • Fail-safe Defaults: Denying access by default unless explicitly granted.

  • Economy of Mechanism: Keeping protection design simple for reliability.

Protection Ring Model (Explain with Diagram):

  • Organizes system in concentric rings (e.g., Ring 0 to Ring 3).

  • Ring 0: Kernel mode with full privileges.

  • Ring 3: User mode with limited privileges.

  • Prevents user applications from directly accessing hardware, enforcing layered security and controlled access to critical operations.
